column1: This project analyzes a supply chain dataset comprising 100 products to identify supplier performance patterns
- **Supplier Count & Distribution:** Identify the number of suppliers and evaluate how many products each supplier manages.
- **Quality Control & Risk:** Pinpoint how many products failed inspection and determine which suppliers are responsible for the highest defect/failure rates.
- **Inventory & Stock Management:** Identify products with stock levels falling below availability thresholds.
- **Reorder Viability:** Determine whether a standard one-time replenishment order is sufficient to bring inventory back to safe stock levels.
- **Financials & Logistics:** Understand total revenue generated by product type and analyze geographical supply distributions.
* There are **5 unique suppliers** in the dataset.
